halfLife.notes: Oral fluphenazine t½ ~15–30 hours. CYP2D6 substrate. High EPS risk — potent D2 antagonist. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.notes: Minor metabolites not clinically significant. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: CYP2D6 inhibitors may increase levels and EPS risk. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: FGA — lower metabolic risk than SGAs. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Gradual taper recommended when switching from depot to oral. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Oral tablets and solution available. LAI form = fluphenazine decanoate (Modecate). Oral doses are approximately 40× the decanoate depot dose equivalents. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
